text: Removed the caller-forgeable learned-measurement authorization surface. Measurement is now fixed-only: identity, sparse selection, weighted region, and declared projection. Learned projections are deliberately absent until a design/compiler-owned unforgeable fit capability exists. Replaced the tests and architectural claims; focused MeasurementSuite passes 6/6. Also deleted redundant legacy ClassificationSuite, MvpaCoreSuite, and SampleIdentityRegressionSuite after their oracles/laws moved to the canonical classifier, axis, reindexing, evidence, and design courts.
